story.fact1: Vietnam is the second-largest coffee exporter globally
story.fact2: Coffee cultivation area is about approximately 600,000 hectares
story.fact3: Within this vast expanse, Robusta dominates, covering around 93% of the cultivated land, while Arabica and Liberica combined account for the remaining 7%.
story.fact4: Spanning over 10 hectares, the farm cultivates various coffee varieties such as Catimor, TH1, THA1, and Yellow Catuai, specifically catering to both domestic and international markets with Specialty-grade standards. The coffee at Radar Farm benefits from a semi-organic fertilization approach, implemented beneath the protective canopy of pine forests. Moreover, the farm employs advanced processing techniques that enable precise and synchronized control over the fermentation process.
